decision: A landing zone must be decommissioned through lz-flow-destroy-landing-zone, which returns its subscription to the bank.
why: Manual resource deletion does not return the subscription to the bank for reuse.
steps: Collect the subscription ID and locate its parameter file and landing-zone workflow. Stop if either is missing.
Present what decommissioning permanently removes: deployment stack, resource groups, role assignments, budget, and Defender settings. State that the subscription returns to the bank.
Wait for explicit confirmation, then dispatch lz-flow-destroy-landing-zone with the subscription ID.
Leave file deletion to the workflow, which opens a cleanup PR. A platform engineer reviews the PR; merge initiates Azure cleanup and returns the subscription to the bank.
violations: Landing zone resources deleted by hand instead of through the workflow.
Subscription cancelled rather than returned to the bank.
